method: Three serialized proc_listpids calls per flavor (PROC_ALL_PIDS=1, selector0; PROC_PGRP_ONLY=2, own current group), buffer32769 c_int entries; clear errno before each call; preserve returned byte count and every returned PID. One second between pairs.
binding: Reviewed host_guard_v2 MacProvider libproc signature; v3 guard was not activated.
outcome: Each global list had499 PIDs including exactly one0; no duplicates, negatives, saturation or missing self. Each current group held self only.
limits: Read-only current-host witness, not universal atomic-snapshot proof.
